tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_activities AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.activity_source, src.deal_id, src.contact_id, src.type, src.subject, src.body, src.task_status, src.due_at, src.completed_at, src.performed_by_user_id, src.assignee_user_id, src.owner_name, src.created_at FROM (
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.organization_id,
  u.activity_source,
  u.deal_id,
  u.contact_id,
  u.type,
  u.subject,
  u.body,
  u.task_status,
  u.due_at,
  u.completed_at,
  u.performed_by_user_id,
  u.assignee_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  u.created_at
FROM (
  SELECT 
    da.id,
    da.organization_id,
    'deal' AS activity_source,
    da.deal_id,
    NULL::text AS contact_id,
    da.type::text AS type,
    da.subject,
    da.body,
    NULL::text AS task_status,
    da.due_at,
    da.completed_at,
    da.created_by_user_id AS performed_by_user_id,
    NULL::bigint AS assignee_user_id,
    da.created_at
  FROM crm.deal_activities da
  WHERE da.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    ca.id,
    ca.organization_id,
    'contact' AS activity_source,
    NULL::text AS deal_id,
    ca.contact_id,
    ca.type::text AS type,
    ca.subject,
    ca.body,
    ca.task_status::text AS task_status,
    ca.due_at,
    ca.completed_at,
    ca.created_by_user_id AS performed_by_user_id,
    ca.assignee_user_id,
    ca.created_at
  FROM crm.contact_activities ca
  WHERE ca.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) u
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = u.performed_by_user_id
) src WHERE src.performed_by_user_id = %(_user_id)s OR src.assignee_user_id = %(_user_id)s OR src.deal_id IN (SELECT d.id FROM crm.deals d WHERE d.organization_id = %(_org_id)s AND (d.owner_user_id = %(_user_id)s OR d.company_id IN (SELECT c_sub.id FROM crm.companies c_sub WHERE c_sub.organization_id = %(_org_id)s AND (c_sub.owner_user_id = %(_user_id)s OR c_sub.parent_company_id IN (  SELECT c_p.id FROM crm.companies c_p   WHERE c_p.organization_id = %(_org_id)s     AND c_p.owner_user_id = %(_user_id)s     AND c_p.channel_role IN ('franchise', 'owned_store', 'brand_hq')))))) OR src.contact_id IN (SELECT cp.id FROM crm.contact_profiles cp WHERE cp.organization_id = %(_org_id)s AND cp.owner_user_id = %(_user_id)s)
)
SELECT type AS activity_type, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS activity_count FROM rpt_activities AS activities WHERE TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE GROUP BY type ORDER BY activity_count DESC LIMIT 500
